'''Mayuki Makiguchi''' (Japanese: '''牧口真幸''' ''Makiguchi Mayuki'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Makiguchi was born on December 4, 1984 in {{wp|Aichi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She began her work on {{aniseries|PTS}} during [[M11|the eleventh movie]] by providing the voices of [[Taka]]. She later went on to voice various Pokémon in [[M12|the twelfth movie]]. Makiguchi later received a major role as {{an|Serena}}, one of {{Ash}}'s {{ashfr|former traveling companions}}, in {{aniseries|XY}}. Makiguchi is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
